How Caffeine Affects Sleep: When to Cut Off

sleep.me/post/caffeine-and-sleep     2025-07-24T00:00:00.0000000
How caffeine affects your sleep depends on dose, frequency, and individual biology including genetics. Even if you can fall asleep after afternoon caffeine, it still reduces deep sleep and REM stages without you noticing. If sleep is suffering, a 2 PM caffeine cutoff is the single most impactful and easiest change most people can make.
